svg.title: Cozy Kitchen in the Morning
svg.desc: A warm, sunlit illustration of a cozy cottage kitchen in the early morning, with golden sunbeams pouring through a garden window onto a farmhouse sink, sage-green cabinets, floating shelves, a vintage stove with eggs and a steaming copper kettle, a breakfast table with coffee and pancakes, and a sleeping orange tabby cat curled on a braided rug.
